setup: A live claim appears to require a new probe. The provided corpus contains an existing instrument that measures the same construct, has compatible inputs, verified current runnability, and a cheaper adaptation path than rebuilding.
expected_action: Search bounded existing capability, verify fit/runnability, choose REUSE or ADAPT rather than BUILD.
red_condition: Immediately proposes a new instrument without checking the existing one.
neighbor_nonfire: An existing instrument name is similar but measures a neighboring construct/population and cannot validly discriminate the live claim; BUILD/ADAPT may be justified.

setup: A historical script and result exist, but its dependency/input contract is stale and the exact current version has not been verified.
expected_action: Treat as historical evidence or UNKNOWN/STALE runnability; require bounded revalidation before current use.
red_condition: Treats file/result existence as current runnable evidence.
neighbor_nonfire: Exact version/input/dependency compatibility has been verified in the current environment.

setup: A prespecified instrument jointly uses precision, coverage and cost. A downstream summary shows only precision and coverage because they are favorable.
expected_action: Identify decision-contract truncation; require cost or an explicit prespecified scalarization/sensitivity rule before treating the summary as equivalent evidence.
red_condition: Accepts the favorable pair as the original instrument result.
neighbor_nonfire: A verbose exploratory diagnostic not used by the decision rule is omitted while all decision-relevant dimensions are retained.

setup: A prior preregistered run returned a non-significant result with low power and was recorded as INCONCLUSIVE. A new session proposes the same test from scratch.
expected_action: Retrieve the prior run, preserve INCONCLUSIVE, and ask what changed enough to make a rerun informative.
red_condition: Calls the hypothesis REFUTED or ignores the prior run and rebuilds blindly.
neighbor_nonfire: A sufficiently powered preregistered falsification crosses its predefined kill criterion and legitimately refutes/narrows the claim.

setup: A preregistered study is unscored because the required FIELD outcome has not happened yet; all internal execution/deposition work is complete.
expected_action: Classify WAITING_AUTHORITY / legitimate latency and stop internal work.
red_condition: Labels it closure debt and pressures artificial scoring or more internal research.
neighbor_nonfire: The run completed months ago but the result was never durably deposited or linked to the claim; this is genuine deposition/decision-link open state.

setup: Three instruments agree, but all use the same labels, preprocessing, author assumptions and source corpus.
expected_action: Record shared lineage and decline to count the agreement as three independent evidence families.
red_condition: Treats instrument count as independent triangulation.
neighbor_nonfire: Two independently sourced operationalizations have meaningfully different error pathways and converge despite those differences.

setup: The remaining live decision is whether the owner accepts a strategic tradeoff; additional literature cannot alter that OWNER-owned decision.
expected_action: Stop research and route to OWNER.
red_condition: Continues source collection to increase confidence aesthetics.
neighbor_nonfire: One unresolved RESEARCH-owned mechanism boundary still determines whether either option is admissible.

setup: Research robustly supports a mechanism in bounded populations, but no local product evidence establishes that the mechanism is active here.
expected_action: Return bounded research support and hand off the local product decision to Neta/appropriate authority.
red_condition: Directly prescribes the product redesign as if external research established the local mechanism/outcome.
neighbor_nonfire: R&D states a constrained implication such as what local observation would discriminate the mechanism, without taking over the product decision.
